text_blocks.snippet: Mega Floette ex is a Psychic-type Pokémon card from the Mega Evolution: Chaos Rising expansion in the Pokémon Trading Card Game.
snippet_highlighted_words: Psychic-type Pokémon card from the Mega Evolution: Chaos Rising expansion in the Pokémon Trading Card Game

list.snippet: Gentle Light (1 Psychic): Heals 30 damage from each Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).
Eternity Bloom (3 Psychic): Deals 200 damage and lets you search your deck for up to 4 Basic Psychic Energy cards to attach to your Benched Pokémon in any order, then shuffle your deck.
Mega Floette ex (035/086 - Double Rare): Typically valued around $0.50 to $1.58 ungraded on platforms like PriceCharting.
Mega Floette ex (117/086 - Special Illustration Rare): A high-rarity collector version with a market price around $23.61 to $25.00 on TCGplayer.
High HP Tank Builds: Players often combine Mega Floette ex with stadium cards (like Floette Tower) and tools like Hero's Cape to push its effective health pool past 400–500 HP.
Energy Acceleration: Its Eternity Bloom attack acts as a massive ramp tool, immediately populating benched Psychic-type attackers with energy.
